user.title: Pair the display
user.description: Enter the six-digit code shown on the display. Home Assistant will find it automatically.

display.title: Choose the display
display.description: More than one unpaired display was found.

pair.title: Pair the display
pair.description: Enter the six-digit code currently shown on display {device}.

dashboard.title: Configure the dashboard
dashboard.description: Choose the heading, minimum update interval, and number of cells in each row. ACT and the last update time are fixed.

item.title: Configure row {row}, item {position}
item.description: Item {position} of {total} in row {row}. The label may be empty. Leave the unit empty to use the Home Assistant unit.

error.cannot_discover: No unpaired display was found. Confirm that the display is showing a pairing code and is connected to the same network.
error.already_paired: This display is already paired. Hold BOOTSEL for five seconds while it is running to reset pairing.
error.invalid_code: The pairing code must contain six digits.
error.invalid_dashboard: The dashboard settings contain unsupported text or values.
error.invalid_item: Check the entity, label, unit, decimal places, and alert settings.

abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered device did not provide a valid identifier.
abort.no_internal_url: Home Assistant does not have an internal URL configured.
abort.local_http_required: The Pico currently requires a local Home Assistant URL using HTTP.
abort.invalid_code: The display rejected the pairing code. Restart setup and enter the current code.
abort.cannot_pair: Home Assistant could not finish pairing with the display.
abort.reconfigured: The display was paired again and its existing layout was preserved.

init.title: Configure the dashboard
